about: Held-out corpus for the shaping vocabulary eval. Each case's reference is what was said; heard is what SpeechTranscriber wrote for it, synthesized with the named say voice. Regenerate heard with scripts/transcribe-shaping-eval-corpus.swift. Learned variants came from a separate training set (Samantha voice, different sentences), so no case here was used to pick them or to tune the candidate thresholds.
